title: Nasi Padang
description: Nasi Padang is a dish from Indonesia prepared with jasmine rice, beef chuck, coconut milk, lemongrass. This is a home-scale version with measured ingredients in the individual steps where they are used. Nasi Padang is a varied meal of rice and multiple side dishes, not one fixed recipe; this is one example plate.

steps.instruction: Rinse the rice, add the listed water, stock, coconut milk and aromatics as specified, cover and cook gently for about 25 minutes until tender and the liquid absorbs.
Combine the remaining ingredients, cover partly and stew gently for about 125 minutes until the flavors meld and everything is tender.
Chop the vegetables as needed. Sauté the listed ingredients over medium heat, stirring, for about 10 minutes until softened and aromatic.
Build one nasi Padang-style plate with rice and the fully cooked coconut beef and vegetables; regional nasi Padang normally offers several distinct side dishes.
Assemble the cooled components with the listed fillings or toppings. Refrigerate briefly if needed to set the layers.
